description: Inputs of the swarm derivation vectors of hugin-network 3.0 (domain-separated topic and mid; lib/swarm.js and the xkr Rust node). Outputs are not stored here: test/swarm.test.js computes them twice (lib, and an independent keccak256 + sodium implementation), compares both and prints them as a 'derivation-vectors' JSON comment for export. Derivation per entry: key bytes K (see key_rule); topicKey = fill32(K) (K repeated/truncated to 32 bytes, like Buffer.alloc(32).fill(K)); base = crypto_sign_seed_keypair(topicKey); topic = keccak256(UTF-8(topic_domain) || base.publicKey) with original Keccak padding (cn_fast_hash), 11 + 32 = 43 input bytes; mid = ed25519 detached signature by base.secretKey over UTF-8(mid_domain) || dht.publicKey, 9 + 32 = 41 bytes; dht = crypto_sign_seed_keypair(dht_seed). The Noise payload format (flag 128, 64-byte mid last) and the protomux channel 'hugin-messages' are unchanged.
dht_public_key_source: hugin-relay.json auth[].pub (key pair of seed 32 x 0x07)

keys.name: room
keys.key_rule: K = sha512(hexbytes(invite)), 64 bytes; fill32 keeps the first 32

keys.name: dm
keys.key_rule: K = sha512(hexbytes(derivation_hash)), 64 bytes; fill32 keeps the first 32

keys.name: private node
keys.key_rule: K = UTF-8(key) where key = the node's XKR address
